title: HP Hampden P1206
memorial_details: A brass plaque mounted on a wooden pedestal alongside a display of relics recovered from HP Hampden P1206. Plaque inscription and names are incised and picked out in black. (See also WM Reference 84564)
inscription: Plaque: THESE ARE THE REMAINS OF HAMPDEN P1206 49 SQN/ LOST ON OPERATIONS 8 NOV 1941/ ALL THE CREW WERE LOST/ (Names)/ THE REMAINS WERE DONATED BY-/ ROYAL NETHERLANDS AIR FORCE
community_connection: The remains were donated by the Royal Netherlands Air Force
